pokemon_species.rule: Extract ID/Name from NDS tables. Map to PMDO species. DO NOT export sprites, stats, portraits, or typings.

moves_skills.rule: Use PMDC SkillData. Extract base power, accuracy, PP if rebalancing is needed. Ignore targeting AI.

combat_ai.rule: Discard ARM9 AI routines. Use PMDC AITactics.

weather.rule: Map NDS weather flags to PMDO MapStatus IDs. Do not recreate mechanics.

dungeon_generation.rule: Extract Floor counts, SpawnLists, Item tables from Sky tables. Generate RogueElements FloorPlan XML.

ground_maps.rule: Unpack Sir0 containers. Extract NDS geometry and palettes. Output perfect .rsground and .tile.

cinematics.rule: Parse .ssb compiled scripts. Extract timings, cameras, flashes, VFX, SFX, BGM, movements. Convert to Lua.

items.rule: Check if item exists in PMDC. If yes: map reference. If no: extract ItemData, icon, and .wan ground sprite.
